entries.title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon
entries.definitive_edition: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archival route because it covers the complete retro companion game with PC capture/settings flexibility. The Nintendo 3DS, Vita, Switch, PS4, and Xbox One releases do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon on Steam for Windows PC and play the native PC release.

entries.title: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night
entries.definitive_edition: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night on Windows PC with Classic II: Dominique's Curse and current DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with current update and DLC support.

primary.version: Current PC build plus Classic II: Dominique's Curse and gameplay DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because it has the complete current content path with PC capture/settings flexibility: the base game, free post-launch modes/characters, paid DLC listed on Steam including Classic II: Dominique's Curse, Iga's Back Pack, and the cosmetic DLC/complete cosmetic bundle. Classic II is the most important completion add-on because it is a separate retro-gameplay story set after Ritual's true ending.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night on Steam for Windows PC, install the current build, then add Classic II: Dominique's Curse and the other listed gameplay/cosmetic DLC if strict completion matters.

entries.title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2
entries.definitive_edition: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archival route because it covers the complete sequel with PC capture/settings flexibility. The game also appears in the Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon Chronicles physical collection on Switch/PS4, but that collection is a packaging convenience rather than unique gameplay content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2 on Steam for Windows PC and play the native PC release. Use the Chronicles collection only if you specifically want both Curse games physically on Switch or PS4.
